name: SIGNL4
label: SIGNL4 — SIGNL4 inbound / resolve webhook API
description: SIGNL4 via the official SIGNL4 inbound / resolve webhook API. Base https://connect.signl4.com/webhook. Docs: https://www.signl4.com/webhook-api/. On-call alerting, not general chat. Team secret is part of the URL — treat as a secret. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One SIGNL4 operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-alert"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-alert | resolve-alert. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: X-S4-Status
schema.description: SIGNL4 status. new (default) | resolved. resolve-alert should send resolved.

schema.label: X-S4-ExternalID
schema.description: Your correlation id. Required on resolve-alert so SIGNL4 can match the open alert.

schema.label: X-S4-Filtering
schema.description: send-alert X-S4-Filtering. true applies team event filters.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-alert, resolve-alert. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: team_secret
configurationParameters.description: Team secret (webhook path segment). StudioQuack secret.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
